statement: The Football Association of Montenegro was admitted to FIFA membership at the FIFA Congress in Zurich on 31 May 2007.
limitations: Association's own account plus a contemporaneous wire report; FIFA primary record (Congress minutes or circular) still pending. Year consistent with FIFA Financial Report 2018 (2007).

statement: SAFA's FIFA membership was reinstated on 3 July 1992 in Zurich, after the earlier expulsion era; the first post-isolation international followed on 7 July 1992.
limitations: Non-FIFA sources only (WebSearch excerpts of BBC Sport and an academic paper citing FIFA Archives give the same date but were not downloadable). Year consistent with FIFA Financial Report 2018 (1992).

statement: UEFA's official history states the LFF was readmitted to FIFA on 9 December 1991.
limitations: Conflicts with the FIFA Financial Report 2018, which records Lithuania's affiliation years as 1923/1992 (re-affiliation year 1992). Both are official accounts of different bodies; the actual decision date must be settled from FIFA records.

statement: The FIFA Financial Report 2018 records Lithuania's affiliation years as 1923/1992, i.e. a re-affiliation year of 1992.
limitations: Year-level only; conflicts with UEFA's official 9 December 1991 readmission date (AGB1-C003).

statement: The FIFA Financial Report 2018 records Latvia's affiliation years as 1923/1992, i.e. a re-affiliation year of 1992.
limitations: Year-level only; no exact readmission day found in this batch (WebSearch returned only year-level statements for Latvia).

statement: The FIFA Financial Report 2018 records Estonia's affiliation years as 1923/1992, i.e. a re-affiliation year of 1992.
limitations: Year-level only; no exact readmission day searched in this batch beyond the FIFA report and a Wikipedia-mirror statement (not saved).

statement: The Croatian Football Federation states it was (re-)admitted to FIFA on 3 July 1992, after a first 1941 admission; UEFA membership followed on 17 June 1993.
limitations: Association's own account, not a FIFA document; consistent with the 1992 affiliation year in the FIFA Financial Report 2018. One low-quality mirror (grokipedia) gives 17 July 1992 and was not saved; conflict possible until FIFA primary is obtained.

statement: At the 49th FIFA Congress held on 16 June 1994, the Congress unanimously admitted 14 new member associations, including the Czech Republic and Slovakia.
limitations: Contemporaneous press report, not a FIFA primary record; the dispatch does not enumerate all 14 admitted members.

statement: At the same 49th FIFA Congress on 16 June 1994, the Congress rejected the Bosnia and Herzegovina association's membership application, so it was not a FIFA member as of that date.
limitations: Press report of the Congress decision, not FIFA primary; supports non-membership up to 16 June 1994 only, with no statement about later dates.

statement: The seven former-Soviet republics admitted at the 49th FIFA Congress on 16 June 1994 are identified (inference) as Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Moldova, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan; the FIFA Financial Report 2018 lists all seven with affiliation year 1994.
limitations: The 'seven republics' list is an inference, not stated in the source; possible that one or more of these FAs was admitted earlier in 1994 by another decision. Needs FIFA Congress minutes or circulars.

statement: The DFV applied for FIFA membership on 6 February 1951, was accepted as a provisional member on 6 October 1951 and as a full member on 24 July 1952.
limitations: Encyclopedic secondary source only; no FIFA primary record. The German DR does not appear in the 2018 affiliation-year list (dissolved associations are absent), so no FIFA-primary anchor exists at all for this membership spell yet.

statement: The DFV ceased to exist as a separate FIFA member when German football unified: Germany reunified on 3 October 1990 and the DFV merged into the DFB; the last GDR international was played 12 September 1990.
limitations: Same as AGB1-C011; whether the FIFA membership formally ended exactly at reunification or earlier (DFB absorption process) is not established by FIFA records in this batch.

statement: The PFA was affiliated to FIFA as a full member at FIFA's 51st Ordinary Congress in Paris on 8 June 1998; before that it held provisional membership from May 1995 restricted to friendly matches played in the territory of another FIFA-affiliated association.
limitations: Historical research website, not FIFA primary; consistent with the 1998 affiliation year in the FIFA Financial Report 2018. The 1995 provisional-membership month is given only as 'May 1995' (no day).

statement: On 13 October 1979 the FIFA Executive Committee passed a resolution readmitting the CFA as a member.
limitations: Search-excerpt-only evidence from a Wikipedia mirror; page could not be saved. Decision date vs effective membership date remains unresolved (see AGB1-C015).

statement: On 7 July 1980 the 42nd FIFA Congress approved the Executive Committee's decision restoring the CFA's lawful rights in FIFA.
limitations: Search-excerpt-only evidence; the interplay between the 1979 ExCo decision and the 1980 Congress approval (which one made CFA a member in good standing for match purposes) is not settled by this batch.

statement: The BHFF became a full member of FIFA in 1996 (year-level; official strategy timeline), after applying in 1992 and being rejected at the 1994 Congress.
limitations: Year-level only; no exact admission day. PDF text extraction failed (image timeline), so fact read from search excerpt of the official document. One unverified online claim (grokipedia, not saved) gives 12 December 1996.
